'''Amitava Bhattacharjee''' is a theoretical [[Plasma (physics)|plasma]] physicist and a professor at [[Princeton University]]. He was awarded the [[James Clerk Maxwell Prize for Plasma Physics|2022 James Clerk Maxwell Prize for Plasma Physics]] for his work on [[dusty plasma]]s and fundamental plasma processes such as [[magnetic reconnection]], [[magnetohydrodynamic turbulence]] and dynamo actions, as well as his contributions in connecting laboratory plasmas to [[astrophysical plasma]]s.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2022 James Clerk Maxwell Prize for Plasma Physics Recipient |url=http://www.aps.org/programs/honors/prizes/prizerecipient.cfm |access-date=2022-09-10 |website=www.aps.org |language=en}}</ref>
